currency.title: Channel currency
currency.description: The points viewers collect in your channel.
currency.enabledHelp: When it is off, viewers earn nothing and the currency commands stay quiet.
currency.name: Currency name

rules.title: Earning rules
rules.description: How viewers earn the currency. One rule per source.
rules.empty: No earning rules yet. Viewers earn nothing until you add one.
rules.error: The earning rules could not load.
rules.confirmBody: Viewers stop earning from this source. Balances they already have stay.

dialog.description: Choose what viewers do to earn, and how much they get.
dialog.windowHelp: For chat and watch time: how often a viewer can earn. Leave empty for each event.

balances.title: Viewer balances
balances.description: What each viewer holds. A frozen wallet cannot earn or spend.
balances.empty: No wallets yet. A viewer gets one when they first earn currency.

dialog.title: Adjust balance of {name}
dialog.description: Now {balance}. A positive amount adds, a negative amount takes away.
dialog.amountHelp: A whole number. Use a minus sign to take currency away.
dialog.invalid: Enter a whole amount that is not zero, and a reason.

jars.title: Savings jars
jars.description: Shared pots viewers fill toward a goal.
jars.error: The savings jars could not load.
jars.confirmBody: The jar and its balance are removed.
jars.notYet: Not available here yet. For now, jar deposits come from the Contribute to jar step in a pipeline.

dialog.title: New savings jar
dialog.description: The jar starts open, so viewers can put currency in right away.
dialog.name: Jar name
dialog.maxWithdrawalHelp: The most one channel can take out. Leave empty for no limit.

invite.title: Invite a channel to {name}
invite.description: The other channel has to accept before it can use the jar.
invite.targetHelp: The ID of the channel you invite.

catalog.title: Store items
catalog.description: Things viewers buy with the currency.
catalog.error: The store items could not load.
catalog.confirmBody: Viewers can no longer buy it. Past purchases stay.

dialog.description: Set what it costs, what it runs and who can buy it.
dialog.name: Item name
dialog.sinkHelp: What the item does when bought. You cannot change it later.
dialog.stockHelp: How many can be bought in total. Leave empty for no limit.
dialog.perStreamHelp: How many one viewer can buy each stream. Leave empty for no limit.
dialog.perUserHelp: When on, each viewer has their own cooldown. When off, one cooldown covers everyone.

dialog.description: Choose what it ranks and who can see it.
dialog.publicHelp: When off, only you see this ranking.
